## ColumnAttributes interface

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

The dialect-neutral description a grammar compiles into SQL.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface ColumnAttributes 
```

## Remarks

This is the wire format between the builder and the grammars. It is exposed so custom grammars can be written against it, which is also why it is `@beta` — fields will be added here as the builder grows column modifiers.
